#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int w;
    long long n;
    cin >> w >> n;

    int k = 0;
    if (w > 2) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
            k = i;
            if (pow(w, i) > 1e9) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    unordered_set<long long> set;
    if (w > 2) {
        vector<long long> pows(k + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            pows[i] = (long long)pow(w, i);
        }
        int limit = 1 << (k + 1);
        for (int mask = 0; mask < limit; mask++) {
            long long sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                    sum += pows[i];
                }
            }
            set.insert(sum);
        }
    }

    bool bol = (w == 2);
    for (long long i : set) {
        if (i >= n && set.count(i - n)) {
            bol = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << (bol ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;

    return 0;
}
